notes: No COBOL/GnuCOBOL task exists anywhere in the 56k pool (searched 'COBOL|cobc|GnuCOBOL' = 0 hits), so domain scores are capped everywhere. The only COBOL-adjacent domain signal is LDPL (a COBOL-descended English-syntax language) in RTS and TerminalWorld, but those tasks are only compile-and-run chores, so they score high on domain and low on skill. TMax is overwhelmingly the right pool: it contains ~570 tasks demanding bit-exact equivalence with a reference implementation, and a dozen that are genuine source-to-source ports (the ones ranked here were picked over the more numerous 'reverse-engineer a stripped binary' variants because cobol-modernization gives you readable source). SWE-Rebench's pyccel cluster is the only true cross-language-semantics domain in the two SWE corpora and is underweighted by the lexical retrievers (most pyccel entries were in rest_ids or absent). RTS and TerminalWorld are genuinely weak here; their ranks 6-10 are filler and should be treated as such by the merge.
